name: Group theory from the solution of polynomial equations
summary: Permutations of roots, first a tool for solving equations, become an object studied for its own structure and are then axiomatised independently of permutations.

name: The probabilistic method in combinatorics
summary: Existence of a combinatorial object is proved by showing a random object has the property with positive probability.

name: Hodge theory proves log-concavity conjectures
summary: Heron-Rota-Welsh log-concavity of chromatic polynomials and Rota's conjecture are proved using Hodge-Riemann relations on Chow rings of matroid-like objects.

name: Non-Euclidean geometry: the independence of the parallel postulate
summary: After Saccheri and Lambert explored denials of the fifth postulate, Gauss privately, then Bolyai and Lobachevsky openly, developed a consistent geometry with many parallels.

name: Erdos discrepancy
summary: Tao used Polymath5's reduction and Fourier/entropy methods for multiplicative functions to settle the Erdos discrepancy problem; SAT solvers had done the c=2 case earlier.

name: Lenstra-Lenstra-Lovasz lattice basis reduction
summary: Geometry-of-numbers ideas give a polynomial-time algorithm that factors polynomials and attacks integer programming and knapsack cryptosystems.

name: Differential equations from calculus
summary: Newton solved fluxional equations by series; Leibniz separated variables; Bernoullis solved named equations.

name: Positive Grassmannian as a hub between combinatorics, probability and integrable systems
summary: Total positivity extended to the Grassmannian produced cell-counting polynomials that also give probabilities in exclusion processes and describe soliton solutions of the KP equation.

name: Steinitz abstract field theory
summary: Steinitz gave the first abstract definition of field and proved every field has an algebraic closure.

name: Category theory
summary: Natural isomorphisms noticed in homology computations are formalised as functors and natural transformations, and the resulting structure becomes a general language.
